##### Project general facts

Hayat 6 by Dubai South Properties is a masterfully planned gated residential community offering an exceptional range of 4-bedroom and 5-bedroom homes, including townhouses, semi-detached villas, and premium units designed to suit modern family living. The development reflects a refined contemporary aesthetic inspired by nature, with clean lines, natural materials, and soft tones that create a calm and timeless visual identity. Thoughtfully positioned across a beautifully landscaped environment, each home offers generous private gardens, open-plan living areas, roof terraces, and versatile spaces that effortlessly adapt to every lifestyle.

Residents of Hayat 6 enjoy an outstanding collection of amenities designed to elevate everyday life, including a stunning central lake, swimming pools, and beautifully landscaped parks with shaded walking trails. A dedicated Club House, sports zones, fitness and wellness facilities, and family play areas ensure that every member of the household has space to thrive and stay active. The community is further enriched by a vibrant neighbourhood mall, a retail boulevard, cafés and dining options, all set within welcoming public spaces that foster genuine connection and a warm sense of belonging.

Interiors at Hayat 6 are thoughtfully crafted to maximise natural light, comfort, and functionality, with open layouts that flow effortlessly between living, dining, and outdoor spaces. Each home features premium-quality finishes throughout, with carefully selected natural materials, stylish kitchen fittings, and sophisticated detailing that speak to a refined sense of taste. From the master bedroom suites to the family halls, every space has been designed with care and precision to deliver a home that is as beautiful as it is liveable.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South - is a dynamic and strategically planned district located in the southern part of Dubai. It serves as a major hub for economic, commercial, and logistical activities, designed with a vision to support the growth of various industries. One of its standout features is its proximity to the Al Maktoum International Airport, the world's largest airport in terms of cargo volume, making it a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors.

In addition to its logistical prowess, Dubai South is home to the Dubai Expo 2020 site, which served as a testament to the district's capacity to host large-scale global events. The Expo site has now transitioned into a legacy district, offering a wide range of amenities and infrastructure, including residential communities, educational institutions, and recreational facilities. Dubai South's commitment to sustainability is evident in its green initiatives, with a focus on eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings.

Dubai South continues to grow as a thriving business and residential hub, attracting both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for businesses and individuals alike, contributing to the ongoing development and economic diversification of Dubai.
